==================================================================
Template argument with `>=` relational expression
==================================================================

template<typename Op, typename... Ts, typename = std::enable_if_t<sizeof...(Ts) >= 1>>
struct D {};

template<int N> struct W {};
W<3 >= 2> w1;
template<typename T, T v> struct IC {};
IC<int, sizeof(int) >= 4> ic;
W<3> w2 = 4 > w1;

---

(translation_unit
  (template_declaration
    (template_parameter_list
      (type_parameter_declaration
        (type_identifier))
      (variadic_type_parameter_declaration
        (type_identifier))
      (optional_type_parameter_declaration
        (qualified_identifier
          (namespace_identifier)
          (template_type
            (type_identifier)
            (template_argument_list
              (binary_expression
                (sizeof_expression
                  (identifier))
                (number_literal)))))))
    (struct_specifier
      (type_identifier)
      (field_declaration_list)))
  (template_declaration
    (template_parameter_list
      (parameter_declaration
        (primitive_type)
        (identifier)))
    (struct_specifier
      (type_identifier)
      (field_declaration_list)))
  (declaration
    (template_type
      (type_identifier)
      (template_argument_list
        (binary_expression
          (number_literal)
          (number_literal))))
    (identifier))
  (template_declaration
    (template_parameter_list
      (type_parameter_declaration
        (type_identifier))
      (parameter_declaration
        (type_identifier)
        (identifier)))
    (struct_specifier
      (type_identifier)
      (field_declaration_list)))
  (declaration
    (template_type
      (type_identifier)
      (template_argument_list
        (type_descriptor
          (primitive_type))
        (binary_expression
          (sizeof_expression
            (type_descriptor
              (primitive_type)))
          (number_literal))))
    (identifier))
  (declaration
    (template_type
      (type_identifier)
      (template_argument_list
        (number_literal)))
    (init_declarator
      (identifier)
      (binary_expression
        (number_literal)
        (identifier)))))

==================================================================
Adjacent `>=` vs spaced `> =` in template position
==================================================================

template<int N> struct W {};
W<3>= 2> a;
W<3> b = c;

---

(translation_unit
  (template_declaration
    (template_parameter_list
      (parameter_declaration
        (primitive_type)
        (identifier)))
    (struct_specifier
      (type_identifier)
      (field_declaration_list)))
  (declaration
    (template_type
      (type_identifier)
      (template_argument_list
        (binary_expression
          (number_literal)
          (number_literal))))
    (identifier))
  (declaration
    (template_type
      (type_identifier)
      (template_argument_list
        (number_literal)))
    (init_declarator
      (identifier)
      (identifier))))
